protocol.method: Execute a Python-based search tree traversal simulation. The agent identifies reasoning 'blind spots' by detecting branches where state-space evaluation diverges from ground truth. The experiment compares standard LLM chain-of-thought outputs against explicitly forced path expansions in the search tree.
protocol.stop: Maximum 48 provider calls per trial set.
protocol.success: Identification of at least 3 distinct reasoning branch failure modes in standard LLM outputs that are mitigated by expanding the search path.

limits: Finite computational evidence does not establish a general theorem or natural-science discovery.

Execution validity, measurement validity, model interpretation and replication are separate fields.
